g.text: Biofouling
Growth on the hull, in sea chests and in every
niche area — bow thruster tunnels, gratings.
Two costs
Invasive species carried between ecosystems.
Added hull friction: more power for the same
speed, so more fuel burned and more CO2.
Managed with a biofouling management plan,
a record book and planned in-water cleaning.
AFS Convention
Controls what may be used in the coating.
Banned
Organotin compounds acting as biocides —
TBT — banned since 2008.
Cybutryne banned from 2023.
Carried on board
IAFS Certificate with a record of the coating
system applied.
End of life — Hong Kong Convention
Inventory of Hazardous Materials (IHM)
Part I is kept and maintained throughout the ship's whole service life, not written at the end.
Parts II and III are added before the ship goes for recycling.
Ship Recycling Plan
Prepared by an authorised yard for that specific ship, based on its IHM.
